reasoning_content:
Interesting — even with diarize: false, the job is still failing at the diarization repo id. The error message is the same as before. Probably the DB (asr-service.db) had the old preset saved from before (preset_manager.load_all() merges DB entries with the config, and for the same id the DB entry takes priority: "database entries are the latest values for presets edited via the API"). The old preset (with model_path set and diarize: true) is persisted in /data/asr-service.db. In other words, the config change is being overridden by the persisted preset.

Fix: clear the ASR service's data volume (delete .local/data/asr), or delete the row in the preset table, and then restart. This volume is .local/data/asr.

Let's stop asr-service, delete the DB, restart it, and re-trigger.

action.command: cd /workspace/deployments/example-opencode && timeout 60 docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml stop asr-service 2>&1 | tail -1; rm -rf .local/data/asr && echo "ASR data volume cleared"; timeout 120 docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml start asr-service 2>&1 | tail -1; sleep 20; docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml ps --format '{{.Name}}: {{.Status}}' | grep asr; docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml logs --tail 6 asr-service 2>&1 | tr '\r' '\n' | grep -vE "DEBUG|httpcore" | tail -6

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/deployments/example-opencode && timeout 60 docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml stop asr-service 2>&1 | tail -1; rm -rf .local/data/asr && echo \"ASR data volume cleared\"; timeout 120 docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml start asr-service 2>&1 | tail -1; sleep 20; docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml ps --format '{{.Name}}: {{.Status}}' | grep asr; docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml logs --tail 6 asr-service 2>&1 | tr '\\r' '\\n' | grep -vE \"DEBUG|httpcore\" | tail -6", "security_risk": "HIGH", "summary": "Clear ASR DB and restart service"}

summary: Clear ASR DB and restart service
